application_type_full: Tree works: Trees in conservation areas/subject to TPOs
description:
T1 Acer (sect. Macrantha) Reduce tree by approx 2.5m from branch tips all round to previous pruning points and retain furnishing growth and natural outline. 

T2 Sycamore: Reduce lateral spread over Willow Bridge rd by approx 3m from branch tips to rebalance crown. Crown heavily unbalanced east facing side. 

T3 Sycamore: Reduce lateral spread over Willow Bridge rd by approx 2m from branch tips to rebalance crown

T4 Sycamore: Reduce lateral spread over New River by approx 2m to rebalance crown. Crown heavily unbalanced south facing side. 

T5 Lime tree: Reduce 2m all round to previous pruning points. Reduce over extended laterals over new river by 2.5m. 

T6 Sycamore: Reduce lateral spread by 2m to previous pruning points. 
Reduce height of tree by approx 2m below previous pruning points. Equates to approximately 4.5m in overall height reduction.
